mapDescription: A generic business capability map covering core enterprise functions: customer engagement, product, operations, finance, people, technology, and corporate governance. Suitable as a starting template for most B2B/B2C organisations.

capabilities.name: Customer Management
capabilities.definition: Acquire, serve, and retain customers across all channels and lifecycle stages.
capabilities.strategySupport: Drives revenue growth and customer lifetime value.
capabilities.architecturalNuance: Typically anchored on a CRM platform with integrations to marketing automation, service, and commerce.

children.name: Marketing
children.definition: Generate awareness and demand for products and services.

children.name: Campaign Management
children.definition: Plan, execute, and measure multi-channel marketing campaigns.

children.name: Brand Management
children.definition: Steward brand identity, messaging, and assets.

children.name: Customer Segmentation
children.definition: Group customers by behaviour, value, and need to target offers.

children.name: Sales
children.definition: Convert leads into closed-won opportunities.

children.name: Lead Management
children.definition: Capture, qualify, and route leads to sales.

children.name: Opportunity Management
children.definition: Progress qualified deals through the sales pipeline to close.

children.name: Quote & Proposal
children.definition: Configure, price, and propose offers to prospective buyers.

children.name: Service
children.definition: Resolve customer issues and deliver post-sale value.

children.name: Case Management
children.definition: Log, route, and resolve customer enquiries and complaints.

children.name: Knowledge Management
children.definition: Author and surface knowledge articles for self-service and agents.

children.name: Field Service
children.definition: Dispatch and manage on-site work by technicians.

capabilities.name: Product Management
capabilities.definition: Conceive, design, build, and lifecycle-manage products and services.
capabilities.strategySupport: Aligns offerings to market needs and competitive position.

children.name: Product Strategy
children.definition: Set product vision, roadmap, and portfolio mix.

children.name: Roadmap Planning
children.definition: Sequence product investments over time horizons.

children.name: Market Research
children.definition: Investigate customer needs, competitors, and market trends.

children.name: Product Development
children.definition: Design, build, and release products to market.

children.name: Design
children.definition: Define UX, industrial, and service design.

children.name: Engineering
children.definition: Build and test the product to specification.

children.name: Release Management
children.definition: Coordinate go-to-market launches and version rollouts.

children.name: Product Lifecycle
children.definition: Manage products from launch through retirement.

children.name: Catalog Management
children.definition: Maintain product master data, SKUs, and bundles.

children.name: Pricing Management
children.definition: Set list prices, discounts, and price book rules.

capabilities.name: Operations
capabilities.definition: Plan and execute the supply, production, and delivery of goods and services.

children.name: Supply Chain
children.definition: Source, plan, and move materials and goods.

children.name: Procurement
children.definition: Source and contract suppliers; raise and pay POs.

children.name: Inventory Management
children.definition: Track on-hand stock, replenishment, and warehouse movements.

children.name: Logistics
children.definition: Plan and execute inbound and outbound transport.

children.name: Order Fulfilment
children.definition: Take orders and deliver them accurately and on time.

children.name: Order Management
children.definition: Capture, validate, and orchestrate orders to fulfilment.

children.name: Delivery
children.definition: Pick, pack, and ship to the customer.

children.name: Quality Management
children.definition: Ensure outputs meet defined quality standards.

children.name: Quality Assurance
children.definition: Define and audit quality processes and controls.

children.name: Continuous Improvement
children.definition: Identify and implement process improvements.

capabilities.name: Finance
capabilities.definition: Manage capital, revenue, costs, and reporting obligations.

children.name: Accounting
children.definition: Record and report financial transactions.

children.name: General Ledger
children.definition: Maintain the chart of accounts and post journals.

children.name: Accounts Payable
children.definition: Process and pay supplier invoices.

children.name: Accounts Receivable
children.definition: Invoice customers and collect payments.

children.name: Financial Planning
children.definition: Plan, budget, and forecast financial performance.

children.name: Budgeting
children.definition: Set annual and multi-year operating and capital budgets.

children.name: Forecasting
children.definition: Project revenue, cost, and cash on a rolling basis.

children.name: Treasury & Tax
children.definition: Manage cash, funding, FX, and tax obligations.

children.name: Cash Management
children.definition: Optimise liquidity across bank accounts and entities.

children.name: Tax Compliance
children.definition: Calculate and file tax returns; manage audits.

capabilities.name: People & Culture
capabilities.definition: Attract, develop, reward, and retain a productive workforce.

children.name: Talent Management
children.definition: Hire and grow the right people.

children.name: Talent Acquisition
children.definition: Source, interview, and onboard new hires.

children.name: Learning & Development
children.definition: Build skills through training, coaching, and certification.

children.name: Performance Management
children.definition: Set goals, review performance, and manage succession.

children.name: Rewards & HR Operations
children.definition: Pay, benefits, and day-to-day HR services.

children.name: Payroll
children.definition: Calculate and pay employees accurately and on time.

children.name: Benefits Administration
children.definition: Manage health, retirement, and leave benefits.

capabilities.name: Technology
capabilities.definition: Provide the digital platforms, data, and security that power the business.

children.name: Application Management
children.definition: Deliver and operate business applications.

children.name: Software Delivery
children.definition: Build, integrate, and deploy software changes.

children.name: Application Support
children.definition: Operate, monitor, and resolve incidents in production apps.

children.name: Infrastructure & Cloud
children.definition: Compute, network, and storage for all workloads.

children.name: Cloud Platform
children.definition: Provision and manage IaaS/PaaS environments.

children.name: Network Services
children.definition: Operate connectivity, DNS, and edge services.

children.name: End-User Computing
children.definition: Provide laptops, collaboration tools, and access for staff.

children.name: Data & Analytics
children.definition: Collect, govern, and analyse data for decisions.

children.name: Data Governance
children.definition: Define data ownership, quality rules, and lineage.

children.name: Business Intelligence
children.definition: Report and visualise performance metrics.

children.name: AI & Machine Learning
children.definition: Develop and operate predictive and generative AI models.

children.name: Cybersecurity
children.definition: Protect information, identities, and systems.

children.name: Identity & Access Management
children.definition: Authenticate users and authorise access to resources.

children.name: Security Operations
children.definition: Detect and respond to cyber threats.

capabilities.name: Corporate Services
capabilities.definition: Strategy, governance, legal, and enterprise-wide enabling functions.

children.name: Strategy & Planning
children.definition: Set enterprise direction and measure execution.

children.name: Enterprise Strategy
children.definition: Define mission, vision, and multi-year strategic plan.

children.name: Portfolio Management
children.definition: Prioritise and govern the portfolio of programs and projects.

children.name: Governance, Risk & Compliance
children.definition: Manage enterprise risk and meet regulatory obligations.

children.name: Risk Management
children.definition: Identify, assess, and mitigate enterprise risks.

children.name: Compliance
children.definition: Ensure adherence to laws, regulations, and policies.

children.name: Internal Audit
children.definition: Independently assess controls and assurance.

children.name: Legal
children.definition: Provide legal advice and manage contracts and disputes.

children.name: Contract Management
children.definition: Draft, negotiate, and steward contracts through their lifecycle.

children.name: Dispute Resolution
children.definition: Manage litigation, arbitration, and regulatory matters.

children.name: Communications
children.definition: Internal and external messaging and stakeholder engagement.

children.name: Internal Communications
children.definition: Inform and engage employees.

children.name: Public Relations
children.definition: Manage external media and reputation.
